what: Terrain ak-portmac-dem, heights in metres as little-endian int16, row-major, north up, regular lon/lat grid (cell centres)
source: AWS Terrain Tiles (Mapzen terrarium encoding, public dataset s3://elevation-tiles-prod), zoom 12, 169 tiles, fetched 2026-11-26, bilinear resample; 55 tile-seam spike cells (|h| > 2,500 m or < -150 m) replaced by the median of their valid 5x5 neighbours; water cleaned: a cell becomes water (-1 m) where more than 45 percent of its 9x9 neighbourhood (then 50 percent of 5x5) is at or below 0 m, which removes the terrarium bathymetry blend spikes in Knik Arm and Cook Inlet; land cells more than 30 m above their 5x5 median set to that median; then, in the lowland west of -149.65 below 220 m, cells more than 18 m above the mean of their land neighbours set to that mean, twice (terrarium needles beside the water)
projection: plate carree, cell centres: column i is lon west + (i + 0.5) * dlon, row j is lat north - (j + 0.5) * dlat
